audience: accountants and small business owners who keep their books in SmartAccounts

useCases.title: Check what a client owes or what you owe a vendor
useCases.text: The AI finds a client or vendor and reads the outstanding balance, optionally on a past date and with the open documents.

useCases.title: List sales invoices and find the unpaid ones
useCases.text: The AI lists sales invoices filtered by date, client, number or payment status, such as unpaid or overdue, with amounts, VAT and outstanding amount.

useCases.title: List vendor invoices that are still unpaid
useCases.text: The AI lists purchase invoices filtered by date, vendor or payment status, so you see what you still need to pay this quarter.

useCases.title: Review payments and general ledger entries
useCases.text: The AI lists bank and cash payments with the invoices they paid, and ledger entries filtered by date, type or text.

useCases.title: Check your products, VAT codes and accounts
useCases.text: The AI lists products and services with prices and VAT codes, the VAT rates, and the chart of accounts.

useCases.title: Create a client and book a sales invoice
useCases.text: The AI searches for a client, adds one if missing, and posts a sales invoice from article rows. The invoice is booked to the ledger at once and this server cannot edit it.
